name: highlightjs-message-format
description: highlight.js language for message-format messages, driven by the ANTLR grammar

scripts.build: npm run check-version && npm run generate && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test:update: npm run build && UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 node --test test/
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['build', 'dist', 'src/generated']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
